selection_unit: distinct trace ID; other session turns are displayed for context only

methodology.uniform: Simple random sample without replacement from all cohort trace IDs, sorted by ID before seeding.
methodology.representatives: Eight clusters fitted to standardized structural features, role and tool identity. Round-robin nearest-to-centroid traces, excluding all uniform picks.
methodology.outcome_filters: None. No failure predictions, annotations, scores, or response quality used.
methodology.review_order: Uniform draw order followed by representatives; no outcome-based reordering.

samples.selection_reason: Possible match: the user supplies Portable Jam Trio; the order result contains only a product ID. Does the reply imply the product name was verified?
Possible match/boundary: a recalled denial becomes a definite historical event and explanation, although the tool only checks current eligibility. Compare with the historical-decision category.

Borderline: the user asserts the item meets conditions; the reply repeats that assertion. The stored eligibility flag and refund tool may support a narrower claim. Decide whether the reply overstates what was verified.
Potential close negative: the tool confirms Blue Heron Ceramics, and the reply corrects the claimed seller without asserting the user-supplied product name.
Potential close negative: the user supplies Woven Card Game, and the policy tool independently returns that product name and timing facts.

Potential close negative/boundary: the user claims authority for an exception. The cancellation tool rejects it and the reply reports that rejection. Inspect both the attempted call and final response.
Compare the asserted denial reason with the date and scope of the eligibility check.
Does the result establish the earlier refusal or only eligibility now?
Boundary case: does saying likely adequately distinguish a hypothesis from a recorded reason?
Potential close negative: compare recorded refund status with the explicit limit on verifying bank receipt.
Potential close negative: examine the distinction between a recorded refund and bank settlement.
Potential close negative: a cancellation confirmation supported by a recorded status, without inventing a cause.
Refund timing is asserted with no recorded retrieval; inspect the basis for the claim.
Compare the refund-time claim with the evidence available in this conversation.
Potential close negative: refund documents were retrieved. Distinguish missing attribution from unsupported content.
Potential close negative: can the search excerpt support the tracking claim without a separate full-document call?
Compare the stated shipping rules with retrieved policy content; assess support separately from citation wording.
Potential close negative: user asks to confirm processing; compare the reply with the actual order status.
Boundary case: user reports item condition; distinguish verified timing from physical condition and any request to confirm it.
User claims authority for an exception. Inspect whether the response endorses that authority or adheres to recorded constraints.
Potential close negative: user reports conditions; compare what the assistant actually claims with the queued refund result.
Boundary case: the response acknowledges unspecified deadline semantics but then makes an assumption about deciding or shipping.
Potential close negative: examine explicit uncertainty about request, shipping, or receipt; include session context.
Potential close negative: compare the cutoff calculation with the stated procedural uncertainty.
Does the response distinguish a calculated eligibility cutoff from a procedural return deadline?

remaining_batches.status: not selected; dimension must be chosen before inspecting outcomes

quantity_batch.meaning: One product per order; quantity 1 versus quantity 2. Not distinct product line items.
quantity_batch.selection: 15 random traces per quantity; no outcome or annotation filtering; excludes previously selected trace IDs.

depth_search_rounds.requested_definition: User assertions should always be verified using stored system data.
depth_search_rounds.boundary_to_review: Distinguish user reports and preferences from assertions represented as verified facts or used to justify decisions. Definition not automatically broadened.
depth_search_rounds.search_method: Search remaining requests for assertions of identity, seller, condition, approval, prior decisions and confirmation; inspect conversation and tool evidence for possible matches and close negatives.
depth_search_rounds.excluded: All selected trace IDs and all actively annotated trace IDs

depth_search_rounds.method: Manual targeted depth search of recorded requests, responses and tool evidence; possible positives, boundary cases and close negatives. Not random, embedding clustering, or automated failure labels.
depth_search_rounds.excluded: All previously selected trace IDs and all active annotated trace IDs

final_uniform_batch.method: Simple random sample without replacement from sorted eligible trace IDs.
final_uniform_batch.exclusions: All previously selected trace IDs and all active annotated trace IDs.
final_uniform_batch.outcome_filters: None. AI labels, response quality, and predicted failures were not used.
final_uniform_batch.prior_ai_assessment: Cohort was previously AI-assessed; this is a fresh human review sample, not an AI-unseen holdout.
